$comment: EMPTY, and that is the finished state rather than an unfinished one.
This roster opened on 2026-09-06 with FOUR acknowledged divergences between a chart's
first-boot HelmChart pin and the ArgoCD Application that adopts the same Helm release.
All four were paid the same day, in the order the work-item proposed:
spire-crds      0.5.0   -> 0.6.1     schema diff: 0 removed, 0 added, in all three CRDs
cert-manager    v1.16.2 -> v1.21.1   52 -> 50 objects, nothing added
trust-manager   v0.15.0 -> v0.24.0   14 -> 15, nothing removed; the openziti Role survives
external-secrets 0.10.7 -> 2.10.0    34 -> 44, nothing removed; all ten new CRDs
So `audit-bootstrap-application-pin-parity.ts` is now a FLOOR AT ZERO: any new divergence
is OPEN and fails. The file is kept rather than deleted because the audit reads it, and
because an empty roster with its history is a stronger statement than no roster -- it says
the debt was paid, not that nobody looked.
Each key carries BOTH versions, so re-acknowledging a paid divergence is impossible: the
audit reports a key matching nothing as STALE.
